name: Interviews
description: Transcribes the active interview sequence on this Mac (whisper), finds each answer with the local AI model (Ollama, no internet), groups the answers by the interviewer's question and the questions into broad themes, and puts them on a copy called "<sequence> Cut version": a Chapter marker per question, a Segmentation marker per theme, and the small topics as clip markers on the clip on the top video track (they belong to that footage, so they also show in other sequences that use it). About 20 minutes for an hour of interview. Then Cut, raise & trim answers (Cut versions only) raises each question's answer one track, removes the questions and dead bits in between, puts one adjustment layer per question over the answers and a row above with one layer per theme.

inputs.label: Interviewee (optional)
inputs.placeholder: e.g. Tahnee, used in the outlines

inputs.label: Audio track (optional)
inputs.placeholder: e.g. A1; empty = all unmuted tracks

actions.label: Find answers and add markers
actions.confirm: Transcribe this sequence and find the answers on this Mac? It takes about 20 minutes for an hour of interview. A copy called "<sequence> Cut version" is made and the markers and question layers go on it; the original is not changed.

actions.label: Cut, raise & trim answers
actions.confirm: On this Cut version: cut at every question's answer, move each answer up one track, remove everything between the answers (questions, crew chat, pauses) so the answers run back to back, and add a row of theme layers above the question layers? Links are kept. Only the Cut version changes; no footage is deleted and nothing is saved.
